What is the basic structure of JCL?
Explain JCL DISP parameter

The DISP parameter has three subparameters:

DISP=(status,normal-end,abnormal-end)

Status:
- NEW - Create new dataset
- OLD - Exclusive access to existing dataset
- SHR - Shared access to existing dataset
- MOD - Append to end of dataset

Normal-end (if step completes successfully):
- DELETE - Delete the dataset
- KEEP - Keep without cataloging
- CATLG - Keep and catalog
- PASS - Pass to next step
- UNCATLG - Uncatalog but keep

Abnormal-end (if step fails):
- Same options as normal-end

Examples:
//DD1 DD DSN=NEW.FILE,DISP=(NEW,CATLG,DELETE)
//DD2 DD DSN=EXISTING.FILE,DISP=SHR
//DD3 DD DSN=TEMP.WORK,DISP=(NEW,PASS)
